decisions.reason: A navigation and observation camera close to the firm's space heritage, with its own web page, is cheap to keep and still has unresolved upside in long space procurement cycles, so the option stays open.
A modular camera line with several models fits the firm's strategy of flexible sensors for small satellites, so keeping it preserves several growth options at low marginal cost.
Space situational awareness is a growing but uncertain market, and one year of presence reveals too little about its value to justify abandoning an extension that builds on existing competencies.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, which suggests it is at an early stage, but it is low-cost to keep and fits the docking and small-satellite direction, so the option is retained until results resolve its uncertainty.
